info.longBusinessSummary: Lindsay Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides water management and road infrastructure products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Irrigation and Infrastructure. The Irrigation segment manufactures and markets center pivot, lateral move, and hose reel irrigation systems, as well as large diameter steel tubing and repair and replacement parts for its irrigation systems and controls under the Zimmatic, FieldNET, and FieldWise brands. This segment also offers industrial internet of things technology solutions, data acquisition and management systems, and custom electronic equipment for critical applications under the Elecsys brand; and contract manufacturing services, including contract manufacturing services, including steel tubing production, hot-dip galvanization, fabrication, welding, and related finishing and assembly services. Its Infrastructure segment provides Road Zipper System comprised of T-shaped concrete and steel barriers, barrier transfer machine, and variable length barriers, which are used for highway reconstruction, paving and resurfacing, road widening, median and shoulder construction, and repairs to tunnels and bridges. This segment also offers moveable barriers, specialty barriers, crash cushions and end terminals, road marking and road safety equipment, and railroad signals and structures. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
